_about: Standard Prestasi (Performance Standards) for Pentaksiran Bilik Darjah (PBD). Maps each DSKP learning standard to its six Tahap Penguasaan (TP1-TP6) descriptors. Bilingual (ms/en). The Pedagogy Architect reads this to (a) generate differentiation tiers from the REAL descriptors and (b) write a grounded Pentaksiran (PBD) section. Offline, versioned JSON — edit to add subjects/standards.

standards.topic_en: Cell as a Unit of Life

1.ms: Menamakan struktur asas sel haiwan dan sel tumbuhan.
1.en: Name the basic structures of animal and plant cells.

2.ms: Menyatakan fungsi setiap struktur sel dengan bimbingan.
2.en: State the function of each cell structure with guidance.

3.ms: Melabel dan menerangkan struktur serta fungsi sel haiwan dan tumbuhan.
3.en: Label and explain the structure and function of animal and plant cells.

4.ms: Membandingkan sel haiwan dan sel tumbuhan secara sistematik.
4.en: Systematically compare animal and plant cells.

5.ms: Menganalisis hubungan antara struktur sel dengan fungsinya dalam hidupan.
5.en: Analyse the relationship between cell structure and its function in living things.

6.ms: Menghasilkan model atau analogi kreatif yang menjelaskan organisasi sel kepada orang lain.
6.en: Create a model or creative analogy that explains cell organisation to others.

standards.topic_en: Cell as a Unit of Life

1.ms: Menyebut satu fungsi sel apabila ditunjukkan.
1.en: Recall one cell function when prompted.

2.ms: Menerangkan satu fungsi sel dengan ayat mudah.
2.en: Explain one cell function in a simple sentence.

3.ms: Menyampaikan pemahaman tentang sel kepada rakan dengan ayat sendiri.
3.en: Communicate understanding of cells to a peer in their own words.

4.ms: Menyampaikan perbandingan sel dengan jelas dan tersusun.
4.en: Communicate a cell comparison clearly and in an organised way.

5.ms: Menilai dan mempertahankan penjelasan tentang sel dengan hujah.
5.en: Evaluate and defend an explanation about cells with reasoning.

6.ms: Mencipta persembahan kreatif yang mengajar konsep sel kepada orang lain.
6.en: Create a creative presentation that teaches cell concepts to others.
